purpose: Original saved concept prompts; C was selected. Reference image not redistributed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape 3:2 art-direction presentation board for a Chinese tutorial about recreating a playful hand-drawn code-driven motion graphics video with Codex. This is a visual concept selection board, not a finished video or functional UI. Reference image role: only its CENTRAL cream-colored illustrated editing workspace, phone mockup, cute character and timeline are style references. Ignore all external social media UI, black bars, account avatar, watermarks, counters. Original GPT-inspired mascot replacing the orange Claude-like block character. No orange Claude character. Clear friendly non-human mascot, expressive eyes, compact silhouette and separable arms/legs suitable for later SVG animation.
Layout: label the board with only its single option letter at top left, one large full-body hero mascot at left occupying 35%, one coherent sample animation still at right occupying 60%: a hand-drawn editing workspace with a black smartphone showing a purple night/dance scene, pastel asset cards, a simple bottom timeline, and a smaller instance of SAME mascot physically pulling a timeline handle. Along bottom show three small poses of the SAME mascot: curious thinking, pointing to a result, delighted celebratory hop. Three or four palette swatches. Spacious tidy alignment, readable silhouette, beautiful deliberate art direction. Flat graphic artwork, expressive poses and warm humor. No dense text, no technical notes, no extra brand names, no social media frame. Do not place text labels on the character. A GPT/OpenAI-inspired woven six-loop knot emblem should serve as identity motif; concepts are unofficial. 
Board letter: "A".
Direction A: 'Mint block director'. Closest to reference: warm cream paper #F3EBDD, slightly irregular charcoal thick ink outlines, flat mint/emerald green square body with gently rounded corners, tiny black oval eyes and expressive eyebrows in upper part of body, small WHITE six-loop woven knot emblem centered below face. Thin bendy ink arms and legs, off-white mitten hands, small dark oval shoes. Body itself is the head, no separate human head. Large hero leans forward energetically holding a thin red pointer. Soft apricot, butter yellow, dusty lavender and mint UI accents, offset flat shadow, extremely subtle paper grain, no 3D shading. Simple handmade comic feeling with restrained details.

Board letter: "B".
Direction B: 'Knot-headed cartoon'. A bold recognizable GPT-inspired mascot whose HEAD silhouette is a chunky emerald green six-loop interwoven knot, with two bright expressive eyes and tiny mouth visible in a cream central opening, not a logo printed on a square. Small cream pear-shaped torso, long rubber-hose charcoal arms and legs, mint mittens and rounded charcoal shoes. Six large clear intertwined lobes, not many tangled noodles. Hero cheerfully stands with one hand on hip and the other pointing upward. Midcentury rubber-hose cartoon reinterpreted as contemporary hand-inked editorial animation: sweeping curves, confident bold smooth dark contours, pale mint workspace background, cream UI, butter yellow and cobalt/lavender small accents, flat colors and small graphic shadows. Charming, mischievous, animation-ready and highly legible.

Board letter: "C".
Direction C: 'Pocket terminal robot'. A little off-white retro computer mascot with a distinct thick rounded rectangular CRT monitor head, deep forest-green screen with two mint pixel-like eyes and a simple expressive mouth, a small green woven six-loop knot badge centered on its compact off-white torso. Short green flexible arms with white mittens and stubby green legs with dark boots; no antenna or headphones. Hero holding a small mint play-button tile with both hands proudly, visibly more designed toy robot than a human. Warm ivory paper canvas, forest green, mint and pale yellow palette, a few peach accents. Crisp cut-paper illustration with thin charcoal ink contours and subtle layered offset shadows, modest paper texture, restrained handcrafted editorial quality. Physical paper tabs and cutout timeline cards in the workspace, elegant clear layout, not glossy 3D, not photorealistic.
